observations.previousRejectionHandling: all server rejections deleted the shared refresh session

conclusion.provenStructuralDefect: Each APR process could rotate the same refresh token without an interprocess lock, and any rejected refresh could delete the shared session.
conclusion.lastProviderEventClassification: The exact last event cannot be distinguished between stale-token rotation and the known intermittent Supabase incident because its HTTP response was not persisted.
conclusion.scope: CRM authentication only; no ENEA mutation and no business-rule change.
